content.title: Everything to Know About The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
content.text: Mario and Luigi — and all their friends — are returning to the silver screen for the upcoming The Super Mario Galaxy Movie, the sequel to 2023's blockbuster The Super Mario Bros. Movie.How to WatchLuckily for fans, the new film is from the same team that made the original movie so fun. Filmmakers Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic are back to direct, Matthew Fogel again wrote the screenplay, and Brian Tyler is handling the score once more.The legendary creator of Mario, Nintendo's Shigeru Miyamoto, is one of the film's producers — as he was in the first movie — helping to ensure that details remain faithful to the iconic video game franchise. Chris Meledandri is also back as a producer.RELATED: Who Is Yoshi Gobbling Up in That New Super Mario Galaxy Movie Trailer?While some details of the upcoming film's plot are being kept under wraps — for now — we do know that Mario, Luigi, Princess Peach, Toad, and Yoshi's new adventure will lead them to outer space to battle Bowser Jr. after the events of the first movie have left him desperate for vengeance.Keep reading to find out more about the film, including its release date and all-star cast.When does The Super Mario Galaxy Movie come out?Mark your calendars — The Super Mario Galaxy Movie hits theaters nationwide on Wednesday, April 1, 2026.RELATED: Brie Larson's "Sneaky Announcement" About Playing Rosalina in The Super Mario Galaxy Movie Is Too CuteWatch the trailers for The Super Mario Galaxy Movie One of the best ways to get suitably amped for the upcoming movie is by watching the trailer, here.Another trailer, seen here, begs the question, "who is Yoshi gobbling up in the trailer?" The answer is Kamek, a Magikoopa who is Bowser's advisor.RELATED: How to Stream The Super Mario Bros. Movie Ahead of the Sequel's ReleaseWho is in the cast of The Super Mario Galaxy Movie?The cast of The Super Mario Galaxy Movie is packed with well-known stars, and includes all the fan-favorites from the first movie, plus some great new additions.Here's who will lend their voices — and personalities — to the film:Chris Pratt (Mario)Anya Taylor-Joy (Princess Peach)Charlie Day (Luigi)Jack Black (Bowser)Keegan-Michael Key (Toad)Benny Safdie (Bowser Jr.)Kevin Michael Richardson (Kamek)Brie Larson (Rosalina)Fans are already excited about the addition of newcomers like Benny Safdie and Brie Larson to the cast — but nobody may be more excited than Larson.In a November 2025 Instagram post announcing her role as Rosalina, Larson called it a "dream come true" to be part of The Super Mario Galaxy Movie.
